art_instructions: Set the scene in the sunny front yard of the cozy cottage: creamy white walls with soft sage green shutters and a warm terracotta roof are visible on the left, with a small porch and a cobblestone path running toward the foreground. A leafy tree stands at the right edge of the yard; place its trunk and roots clearly in view where the mouse was previously seen. In the foreground-right on the cobblestone path near the tree roots, place Glaux (the owl) slightly right of center, three-quarters facing left toward the house. She is calm and unafraid: wings tucked, posture upright, round amber eyes relaxed, wearing her small green scarf; her tiny satchel rests closed on the ground just beside her left foot. She gently holds a small gray field mouse in her beak; show only the mouse’s tail and hind feet peeking out, with no blood or gore. To echo earlier play, place the red ball on the grass near the porch steps on the left, slightly out of focus. Border the path with sunflowers and lavender, with a few low berry bushes. Use bright sunlight with soft, crisp shadows falling slightly to the right; no other characters are present.
